comment: Prof Mack is one of the best teachers. Super easy with minimal homework, two essays, and 2-3 online tests. Would definitely recommend any of his classes.

Super sweet professors with small amount of homework required for each class. Each class includes lectures and then small group activities which tend to be article/source analysis. There are two tests which are all online and open notes, and then two primary source analysis papers. Very kind and understanding professor, with clear grading criteria.
Good professor for history ge. As an international student who never took American history before, the class is fine.

Prof. Mack has been one of the best history teachers I have had. He makes the lectures interesting and has a clear passion for history. The course structure is very clear (tests, presentations, papers) and gives you all the information you need to do well in the class.

Take Dr. Mack for your history class. He is very knowledgeable and is always there to help. He is humble and asks for feedback and is intentional with his grading. Overall, a really easy class and quite interesting! Take Dr. Mack!

Mack is an awesome prof for the HIST gen-ed. Super dynamic in class and always tries to keep students engaged. 2 tests (online) and 2 papers + presentation and participation make up the grade. He also teaches many different topics for HIST 199 so you can take one you find most interesting. Highly recommend.

Professor Mack is my favorite professor at UR! He genuinely cares about his students and frequently asks for feedback to improve his teaching. You should expect to do some reading for every class but usually no more than 30 pages. His exams are online and open-book, so take notes during class and while reading and it will be easy.
Very nice man and a very easy course. So long as you participate in class and show any interest in the subject matter, you'll ge ta good grade.

Dr. Mack is the best! I tend to find history boring, but he made it interesting and easy to understand! He's a really great lecturer on the topic and a lenient grader. Overall, a great choice for those that tend to lean away from history and need the gen ed.

I can't recommend Professor Mack enough!! He is by far one of the nicest teachers I have had here at UR. His class is relatively easy and straightforward. If you show up to class, pay attention, and participate, you will do extremely well. I cannot recommend him enough for your history credit.

Take him for your history gen ed. He puts a lot of effort into the class and modeling it around what the students want. There is one big 8 page research paper but he graded it very leniently, almost too much, but I can't complain. Only hw is reading and you don't really need to do it. Super cool and chill professor.

Dr. Mack is the best choice for a history credit. You have three tests that are all online and open note. Otherwise, you have one research paper that is 2000 words and one other shorter reflection paper. He is also a great guy and clearly loves teaching. I would definitely take him again if I can because his class is easy and he is great.

Dr. Mack is a super nice guy. The class is super easy and grades are based off two six page papers, and three online tests. There is daily reading for class, but it isn't necessary. However, it makes class much easier. I was kind of surprised with my grade as I had a high A all semester, and ended with an A-. Take Dr. Mack for a history credit!

Dr. Mack is a super nice guy. The course is lecture based with 2 essays, 3 quizzes, and a participation grade. If you show up and try, you will succeed. He is also super flexible with deadlines if you need help.

Professor Mack is such a great professor. All you need to do in the class is take notes and you'll be fine. You are only graded on 3 tests, 2 essays, and participation, so keep that in mind. Highly, highly recommend Professor Mack for any history or gen ed class you need to take.

Dr. Mack is by far the best professor I've had. You're graded on three online, open note tests, two essays, a presentation, and participation. I never did any of the readings and did just fine.  His online tests are easy and I did well without doing any studying. He also grades so fairly on essays. Definitely take for gen ed requirement

Great Professor! He lectures a lot but all you have to do is take notes and you'll get an A. He makes class engaging so you're not bored during the lectures and loves to answer questions. Don't have to do any of the readings for homework. Only write one 5-page research paper along with a midterm and final exam. Definitely recommend taking Prof Mack

Prof Mack is an excellent teacher who explains the course material well and cares about his students. He takes students' feedback seriously. If you participate and take notes you will do well. He is clear about what you will be graded on and gives you the opportunity to prepare for exams. Definitely take this class for your gened requirement.
Dr. Mack is a great teacher and an even better person. He's very smart and his class is super relaxing. Would definitely take again.
Dr. Mack is one of the kindest professors that I have had. He is the best. I took Hist199 to fulfill my history gened and it was super manageable. Take his class!

This is a great class to take as your history credit. Dr. Mack is one of the nicest professors at UR. He cares about his students are you are told exactly what is expected. He values participation and it will definitely show in your course grade.

If you are looking for a class to fulfill your history gened this class is for you. Dr. Mack is honestly one of the nicest professors there is. He really does try his best to help you. If you participate he will go super easy on grading your items. He also will always take his students' feedback & will adjust class based on what you say.
